_comment: Optional config for session_checkpoint.py. Copy to .claude/continuity.json and edit. Delete any key to use its default.
title: 세션 체크포인트 / Session Checkpoint
_processes_comment: pgrep -f <pattern> for long-running processes to pin in the checkpoint. Empty/omit to skip the process section.
_handoff_comment: Manual handoff doc to extract the pending section from. Omit to auto-detect: CONTINUITY.md > RESTART_PROTOCOL.md > HANDOFF.md > SESSION.md.
_recent_comment: Recently-changed source files to list (orientation for 'what was I working on').
_inject_comment: inject_max_lines bounds how much of latest.md the SessionStart hook injects (keep the restore context small).
_recovery_comment: Optional ordered steps printed under 'Recovery checklist' — your project's first-actions-after-compact.
recovery_checklist: Read this checkpoint + the handoff doc
Check processes against the PIDs above
If the working tree is dirty, finish/commit before new work
_misc_comment: timezone_offset_hours: null = local time; e.g. 9 = KST. keep_backups: timestamped copies to retain. git_log_count: recent commits shown.
